planet: Preserve the published world's retrograde rotation and tilt, radius, gravity, rotation-rate magnitude, year, orbit, stellar input, greenhouse forcing and map scale. Hold all qualified r40 shared physical parameters fixed. Only latitude/orientation, four tier heights and the existing exterior-geography variables are fitted. The start is r40's shared physics with the published r38 world's geometry (coarse probe before this plan: start 0.18384, published r38 0.18906 at ds32 layouts 1-3).
layouts_note: Layouts 17 and 23 were inspected by the r39 campaigns and are development data now; the search trains on all five known layouts (the r39 robust campaign's lesson). Final validation uses nine new layouts below.
objective: zonefit of the five-layout mean climate, matching atlas semantics; race=0
coarse_control: Evaluate the currently published r38 world with the same resolution, five layouts and strict numerical profile.
native_selection: At most the two highest-scoring unique completed parameter sets passing the coarse screen advance, ordered by coarse score. Coarse screen versus the matched old-world control: strict accuracy may fall at most 0.01, each zone's recall at most 0.03, Mediterranean dry share may increase at most 0.01 and Cs share may fall at most 0.03. No numerical failure may advance.
native_check: At downsample 8 and mean layouts 1-3, against the published r38 summary: observed numerical success, zonefit at least +0.001, strict agreement no worse, no zone recall loss greater than 0.02 (tree included), Mediterranean dry-share increase at most 0.005 and Cs-share loss at most 0.02. Try the second finalist only if the first fails.
audit: Only the first native-passing world: matched r38 and the candidate at ds16 on the nine new layouts, unchanged strict numerics, every member saved. Ensemble gate: nine-layout mean-climate zonefit no worse than r38 and strict-agreement loss at most 0.01. Uncertainty gate: nine paired individual-layout zonefit differences with mean > 0 and the lower 2.5th percentile of 20000 paired bootstrap means > 0 (numpy default_rng(594901) on the sorted differences). No interim selection, added layouts or second candidate after the audit.
publication: Only a world passing the native check and both audit gates is staged as an Earth atlas (full climate, food, population, political and market layers) with identity, asset and server checks before replacing canonical files. Otherwise the canonical r38 atlas stays and every result is reported.
